title.narrative: Enhancing Local Infrastructure & Services in Sinjar (ELISS) in Iraq

description.narrative: To address critical problems related to living standards of conflict-affected people, UNOPS manages the restoration of critical public infrastructure, such as schools, war-damaged shelters, water networks and stations. The project also hopes to expand equitable access to services with particular attention to the distinct needs and vulnerabilities of women and girls and introduce renewable energy solutions, where applicable.\n
